ITEM 1 | Main mound of loose, separate grains with orange-tan color and reddish speckles, slightly glossy and moist-looking, spread across about 40% of the plate's upper-center area, roughly 9 cm across and 2 cm tall at the peak, with scattered individual grains around the edge | 170
ITEM 2 | Small pieces of red-orange diced vegetable mixed into the grains, soft and glossy, about 1 cm pieces, sitting within the rice mound near its center | 15
ITEM 3 | Pale yellow-cream chunks with light golden edges, soft and slightly moist, about 2 to 3 cm across, positioned at the lower-left base of the rice mound | 30
ITEM 4 | Dark green leaves, flat and glossy with a slightly wilted look, about 3 to 4 cm long, two or three leaves clustered at the lower-right edge of the mound | 12
ITEM 5 | Smaller green leafy fragments, darker and curled, about 2 cm, lying at the lower-left edge beside the cream chunks | 6
ITEM 6 | Orange-tan oily sauce film pooled beneath the lower-right edge of the rice and leaves, glossy with a thin sheen, covering about 3 cm of plate surface | 8
